companyProfile.traders: Independent traders apply with a CV, broker statements and trade history. They keep their own broker accounts. Records and strategy are reviewed before any copying arrangement; applying does not guarantee selection, a contract or investor capital.
companyProfile.investors: The proposed investment service is for professional clients only, with client assessment and investment management intended to sit with a regulated host firm. An enquiry does not establish eligibility. Do not describe GTT itself as the regulated investment manager or the proposed service as already launched.
companyProfile.supportingProducts: Turtle Analytics and trading journals support historical performance and risk review. The university competition uses virtual capital; competition results are distinct from a verified live trading record and from selection for the proposed investment service.
